rule_or_requirement: Establish whether a privileged TRAIN teacher can recover long pixel-road visibility losses without destroying valid finishes.
observable_information: TRAIN simulator track and car pose for teacher, pixel-road visibility and frozen inherited action; no runtime student yet.
allowed_action_or_state_change: Same frozen 12-meter nearest-road teacher steering when fewer than three road-center rows remain; inherited gas/brake.
expected_success_endpoint: At least three long-loss control cells, all control finishes preserved, total completion no lower, no invalid actions and >=10-decision streak reduction on at least two long-loss cells.
control: Exact frozen visual mode-switch ZIP SHA b0dc7a24e6ef994cee6e663ec6605f5aa088dbb9b3ce4510f90ccd16dc9d7fc4 on 24 matched fresh TRAIN cells.
falsifier: Lost control finish, lower teacher completion, invalid action or fewer than two long-loss streaks shortened; under three long-loss controls is inconclusive.
smallest_decisive_experiment: Two arms on tracks 1-3 x fresh TRAIN seeds 5072-5079, 48 episodes; teacher-only diagnostic.
resource_and_risk_gate: One registered Linux CPU teacher diagnostic capped at 1,200 seconds and 2,000 decisions/episode; no reserved split or external action.
